class.name: SliderJoint3D
class.brief_description: A physics joint that restricts the movement of a 3D physics body along an axis relative to another physics body.
class.description: A physics joint that restricts the movement of a 3D physics body along an axis relative to another physics body. For example, Body A could be a [StaticBody3D] representing a piston base, while Body B could be a [RigidBody3D] representing the piston head, moving up and down.

method.name: set_limit_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables [member linear_limit/enabled]. This boolean API updates the corresponding native joint parameter.

method.name: set_motor_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables [member motor/enabled]. This boolean API updates the corresponding native joint parameter.

method.name: set_spring_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables [member spring/enabled]. This boolean API updates the corresponding native joint parameter.
